news.title: From Data to Decisions: Understanding the Business Case for Private Sector Engagement in Food Security Data
news.summary_en: A significant transformation is underway in how risks across the agricultural and food value chain are understood, managed, and financed, with profound implications for global food security.

news.title: As Fears of China Wane, Americans Favor Greater Engagement with Beijing
news.summary_en: More than half of the US public supports a policy of cooperation and engagement with China, including a growing number of Republicans.
